verdict.rationale: Fidelity Private Shares offers 409A valuations as a platform service included in its Growth plan, fulfilled through third-party valuation providers it works with. Nothing in the evidence shows the valuation is ordered in-platform, generated from live cap table data, audit-ready, or refreshed on a recurring schedule. missing for 10: an in-platform ordering workflow, generation from live cap table data, audit-ready/defensibility documentation, scheduled or recurring refreshes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can order an audit-ready 409A valuation in-platform, generated from my live cap table data, and get refreshed valuations on schedule

citations.quote: We work with third party 409A Valuation Report providers based on your company's individual needs.
Get faster, more accurate, and competitively-priced 409A valuations.
move to our Growth plan with 409A valuations and ASC 718 reporting and more
